data.title: Quality Improvement - Refactoring

data.author: herdr-downtime
data.comment:
## Producer review questions - answered pragmatically

### Q1 (approach): Batching mechanical fixes ✅
The remaining 55 children are all mechanical lint findings (ruff/flake8) in 3 files.
Approach: batch fixes per file (one commit per affected file), close all children
against each commit hash. This is practical because:
- Each child is a single-line fix
- Children are independent (no dependencies)
- Per-child worktree/test-run workflow is wasteful (~30 min full suite × 55 = 27+ hours)

### Q2 (gate timeout): Proceed without waiting for systemic fix ⚠️
Full-suite timeout (SA-0MTXLTKFP000ZUZ8) is tracked separately. Proceeding with
changed-scope test validation per batch. Accepting that full-suite gate may timeout.

### Q3 (dirty tree):  acceptable ✅
Temporary exclusion of  directory via  is acceptable
until SA-0MTYP6T2I00396J7 lands.
